# New SalesMail User? Get Started Here!

Welcome to SalesMail!  You can now use SalesMail to quickly and easily send video messages via text, email, CRM, or social to build stronger relationships and create memorable experiences with the audiences that matter most to you.

Here is how to get started:


1.
**Find the temporary log in information we emailed to your work email address and log in.**
The email was from
[no\_reply@salesmail.app](mailto:no_reply@salesmail.app)
and may be in your junk folder
**.**
You can access your SalesMail account using our mobile SalesMail app downloaded from the App Store or Google Play Store, and/or from your computer using our
[SalesMail Desktop Portal](https://portal.mysalesmail.com/)
(bookmark this link).  When you log in for the first time, you will be prompted to set up a new password.


_Still can't find your temporary login info?_[_Click here_](mailto:support@heartlegacy.zohodesk.com?subject=Send%20new%20SalesMail%20temporary%20password) _to send your work email address and name and we will send a new password shortly._

2.
**Start learning!**
SalesMail is really easy to use and you can record and send videos in just a few clicks.  Are you a self-starter? Here are some quick how-to videos with the basics, or feel free to watch our
[full training video (54 min)](https://support.salesmail.com/portal/en/kb/articles/salesmail-trai) or attend a [live group training](https://support.salesmail.com/portal/en/kb/articles/group-salesmail-training-available-every-thursday) at your convenience.  Enterprise users will also attend live, custom training that will be scheduled by their Client Success Specialist.


1. [SalesMail Mobile App: How to Record and Share a Video (3 min.)](https://support.salesmail.com/portal/en/kb/articles/salesmail-mobile-app-how-to-record-and-share-a-video "SalesMail Mobile App: How to Record and Share a Video (4 min.)")

2. [SalesMail Mobile App: How to Add a Call To Action (CTA) Button To a Video (4 min.)](https://support.salesmail.com/portal/en/kb/articles/salesmail-mobile-app-how-to-add-a-call-to-action-cta-button-to-a-video)

3. [SalesMail Desktop Portal: How to Record a Video (9 min.)](https://support.salesmail.com/portal/en/kb/articles/salesmail-desktop-portal-how-to-record-a-video)

4. [SalesMail Desktop Portal: How to Share a Video (4 min.)](https://support.salesmail.com/portal/en/kb/articles/salesmail-desktop-portal-how-to-share-a-video)


3\.
**Bookmark and use the**
**[SalesMail Help Center](https://support.salesmail.com/portal/en/kb/heartlegacy)**
**.**
Our
[help center](https://support.salesmail.com/portal/en/kb/heartlegacy)
has tons of video ideas, training, example videos, help articles, and inspiration!


4\.
**Follow SalesMail on social to stay up to date on fun contests ($) and other inspirational content.** [Click here](https://www.salesmail.com/social/#comp-jxnbims3)
for convenient links to the SalesMail social sites.


5.
**Need help?**
Email us at
[support@salesmail.com](mailto:support@salesmail.com)
to initiate a support ticket so we can get you the help you need.  Please send the email from your work email address and include your name and details on what we can help with.
